静态目录信息

build_system_prompt
+ 可选 Plan prompt
+ Runtime Fold Guidance

span.p:

当前历史 + retrieved_skills

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

★ retrieved_skills 摘要

span.p:
跨 Session 长期 Memory
~/.skevo/projects/<hash>/memory/*.md

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
主 Agent 且有 side query？
多词输入 / 已注入 < 60 KiB / 存在 Memory？

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

② create_task 启动 prefetch
异步召回最多 5 条；与首轮 API 并发

div.style: color: rgb(7, 59, 76) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
◇ ③ 首轮模型 API
create_task 后至 settled 检查前无 await
不等待、首轮不可能注入 Memory 正文

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
首轮直接 final / 无 tool call
召回结果不进入本次 chat

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 工具执行结果

span.p: UTF-8 结果 > 30 KiB？

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
~/.skevo/tool-results
保存全文；上下文仅保留路径与前 200 行

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
写入当前 backend messages
供下一次模型调用

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
下一迭代汇合
所有 chat 内路径从此回到 loop 顶部

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
每次模型调用前
_run_compression_pipeline

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
① 单结果字符预算
利用率 ≥50%：30k chars
利用率 >70%：15k chars

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
② stale-result snipping
利用率 ≥60%，保留近 3 条
OpenAI：全部符合条件的历史 role=tool
Anthropic：read_file / grep_search
list_files / run_shell

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
③ idle microcompact
距上次 API 调用 ≥5 min
清旧结果并保留近 3 条

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
仅进入下一轮时检查上阶段 task
prefetch settled + unconsumed
且成功返回非空结果？

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
追加到最近 user message
标记 consumed；最多一次

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
未完成 / 失败 / 无结果
不等待；继续本轮

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REPL /compact（chat 外）
Agent.compact → trigger=manual

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
模型调用 compact_context
执行中 trigger=tool

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
工具批次结束后 auto check
last input > 70% effective window？

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
对应 messages ≥ 4
且 transcript 非空？

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 未执行 folding 的 trigger？

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
REPL /compact 返回
Nothing to compact

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OpenAI / Anthropic → transcript
普通 message content 按 12k clip
总 transcript 按 80k clip
OpenAI tool_call.arguments 不单独 12k clip

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
side query 可用
且返回 JSON 可解析？

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ fallback_folded_memory
保留最多 6k transcript 摘要

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
folded session state
episode / working / tool memory

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
追加内存列表
_folded_session_memories

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
尝试 save_folded_session_memory
项目 .skevo/sessions/
写 JSONL + latest artifacts

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⚠ artifacts 写入失败
异常吞掉，不阻断 folding

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
替换当前原始历史
OpenAI：system + folded user
Anthropic：单条 folded user

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 本次 trigger 来源？

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REPL /compact 返回
不产生 tool result / context break

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Anthropic / OpenAI 共同行为
_context_cleared = True
工具结果写为新 user message
停止剩余工具 / context break

div.style: color: rgb(7, 59, 76) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ◇ 后续模型 API

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
后续模型返回 tool call
进入对应工具分支

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 主 Agent chat 正常收尾

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
尝试 _auto_save
best-effort

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
用户级全局 Session JSON
~/.skevo/sessions/<session_id>.json
messages + folded list + metadata

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ Session JSON 写入失败
异常忽略

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ /compact 后若无正常 chat 收尾
folded list 不进入 Session JSON
artifacts 已尝试保存

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
当前 CLI 先创建新 Agent
采用当前 backend / prompt / metadata

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
--resume：get_latest_session_id
仅按 startTime 取用户级全局 latest
不按 cwd / project / backend 筛选

div.style: color: rgb(32, 40, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
load_session → restore_session
只传两种 backend messages
不校验或转换 backend

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 保存 backend = 当前 backend？

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
同 backend：恢复活动 messages
folded user message 可随历史恢复

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⚠ backend 不匹配
历史进入非活动消息列表
当前模型看不到

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ 同 backend OpenAI
保存的旧 system message 覆盖新 prompt
恢复后首轮不 refresh：日期 / cwd / Git /
rules / Memory index 等可能过期

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ 其余恢复缺口
不读取 artifacts；不恢复 folded list
id / model / cwd / startTime 等
仍为新 Agent 当前值
